description: PAID $0.03 (x402, USDC on Base or Solana). One-call research card for a single stock perp: spot quote and market session, perp prices on trade.xyz, Aster and Lighter, gap % per venue vs spot and vs the Solana xStock, funding and basis, recent 72h gap history, and the rule-based verdict. Includes a news block (up to 5 items in 48h: SEC 8-K filings, Fed/BLS macro releases, press-wire items as our own one-line summary + link) and a heuristic news_context label (likely news-driven / news present, move small / possibly macro-driven / no matching news). Data, not financial advice.
name: get_research_card
